values.note: Full hook-up sites (water, sewer, 30/50 amp) $50 a day or $300 a week for 2 adults and 2 children, $5 per extra person a night; tent sites with power and water also $50; cabin $75 plus 13% tax. Monthly and seasonal rates on request. The page gives no year (site footer 2026). Read 2026-10-22.

values.note: Reservations held with a card or one night prepaid by cash/check; call 828-245-4064. Cancelling within 72 hours forfeits a night. Memorial Day and Labor Day weekend reservations are 3 nights, charged in full if cancelled within 7 days. Check-in and check-out 2 pm; visitors $4-5 each.

note: Family-owned campground near Forest City, pet friendly; roughly 70-80 sites, some with water and electric only. Swimming pool, fishing pond, hiking trails, planned activities and a cabin. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: $50/night full hook-up (2+2), 30/50-amp full hookups, pull-thrus; added Passport America (plus Recreation USA/FMCA/AAA), showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, camp store, phone reservations. Not stated by the operator: max rig length (50 ft) or season (year-round), both from note prose, left. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Price gate: base $50/night (full hook-up, 2 adults + 2 children) on the operator's rates page is at the US$50 line, not over it. No gateway within 40 km (Asheville 76 km); no family stays.
